title: Coca-Cola sues Vue after cinema chain switches to Pepsi
summary: Attempt to reclaim alleged unpaid debts comes months after 25-year relationship with cinema chain came to an end Coca-Cola is taking legal action against Vue after the cinema chain switched to arch-rival PepsiCo as its supplier for soft drinks in Europe. Vue, which operates more than 90 cinemas across the UK and Ireland, put the contract up for tender last year. Continue reading...

title: Fake weight-loss medication in tablet form could flood Britain, experts warn
summary: Better regulation and enforcement urged before launch of oral treatments, which criminals are likely to try to exploit Experts are warning that fake weight-loss treatments could become more prevalent as tablet forms of the medications, currently available only via injections in the UK, are launched. They say stronger regulation and enforcement are needed to prevent fraudsters from cashing in on tablets which will be easier to counterfeit. Continue reading...
